name: sf-intelligence
tagline: Ask your AI what breaks before you change Salesforce. Offline, read-only, cited answers.
description: Ask Cline questions about your Salesforce org (can I delete this field? what runs when an Opportunity is saved? is this deployment risky?) and get answers cited from the org's real metadata. The server reads a local `org-kb` vault that the `sfi` CLI builds from your org; it is read-only, runs offline and needs no API keys. Try it first with the bundled demo org, no Salesforce login needed: `npx -y sf-intelligence demo`. Source-available under MIT with Commons Clause. Not affiliated with Salesforce.

env.name: SFI_VAULT
env.description: Absolute path to the org-kb vault built by `sfi init` + `sfi refresh`, e.g. /Users/you/my-sfdx-project/org-kb. Without it the server starts in setup mode and only reports what it looked for.

install.notes: Requires Node.js 20+. Build a vault once inside your Salesforce DX project with `npx -y sf-intelligence init --target-org <alias>` then `npx -y sf-intelligence refresh` (uses your authenticated Salesforce CLI). No org yet? Use `npx -y sf-intelligence demo` instead of `mcp` to serve a synthetic demo org.
